# Hire an Engineer

> Open-source agent skill that turns an AI coding tool (Claude Code, claude.ai, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity) into a senior software engineer and full software team for non-technical builders and vibe coders: planning, project structure, persistent project memory, UI/UX, architecture, databases, API integrations, process automation, test-first development, getting unstuck, releases, documentation and cost tracking for your product. Users can write in English, Urdu, Roman Urdu (for example "mujhe ek software banana hai") or any language; the skill triggers on those requests too.

Tested by the author with Claude Code and claude.ai. Other tools that support Agent Skills or read AGENTS.md are best effort. Not affiliated with Anthropic or the other tools named.

- [README](README.md): what it is, who it's for, start in 2 minutes
- [Install guide](docs/INSTALL.md): per-tool install, update, uninstall, which version you have
- [Skill](skills/hire-an-engineer/SKILL.md): core rules and router
- [Delivery loop](skills/hire-an-engineer/references/delivery-loop.md)
- [Task loop](skills/hire-an-engineer/references/task-loop.md)
